\section{What the analysis notices}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em]
  \item \finding{critical} At least one rank waited 4\,s for an agent to claim its task before the broker gave up. That is a pool-sizing failure outside the protocol, not a slow run.
  \item \finding{note} Parallel efficiency is 22.8\%: 77.2\% of the rank-seconds paid for went unused.
  \item \finding{note} Load imbalance is 3.46$\times$: the slowest rank was busy far longer than the mean.
  \item \finding{ok} 31 rank reattachment(s) occurred, up to incarnation 12: agent processes were replaced mid-run while the rank roles, their mailboxes, and their context accounts persisted.
  \item \finding{ok} All 1 checkable collective(s) sent exactly the number of messages their closed-form cost expression predicts.
  \item \finding{ok} All 1 checkable collective(s) also matched the predicted round count.
\end{itemize}
